properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-10-11, in a chat on the dev_reflow2 hub, after reading that chg:a-decision-resting-on-numbers-keeps-its-math-2026-10-05 says "nothing DETECTS a Decision whose rationale states numbers with no source or computation": "/brainstorm how could we enforce it?"

WHAT IS ALREADY SETTLED, so this is about HOW, not WHETHER: req:a-quantity-carries-how-it-was-obtained-and-an-unsourced-one-is-reported (accepted) covers quantities the design stores in fields (a constraint's limit, a fact's value, an interface's rate). The numbers a Decision's rationale rests on are prose, and that requirement's reporter does not reach them. dec:agent-carries-results in the reflow2 calculator design (accepted) keeps flo2-calc from writing to reflow2 and reflow2 from calling it, so any option below must leave both standing.

THE OPTIONS, offered by the agent, none chosen:
(a) A DETECTOR ON THE PROSE. detect_gaps scans accepted Decisions' decision and rationale text for numbers with units ("7.5 mm", "12 h", "$340"), and reports those with no DOCUMENTS edge from a computation-record Artifact and no worked arithmetic in the text. It is aggregate and low-severity, like unreviewed_ideas. Cheap to build. Counter-argument: heuristic. Dates, versions, PR numbers and counts read as numbers, and "worked arithmetic present" is hard to judge from prose, so expect false positives.
(b) STRUCTURE, NOT PROSE. A Decision names the quantities it rests_on, each a quantity with the provenance the accepted requirement already defines (measured / computed-by-record / asserted-by). The existing unsourced-quantity reporter then covers decisions with no new detector. The most honest option, and it reuses accepted intent. Counter-argument: it asks the agent to fill one more field, and a field left empty is silent unless (a) also exists to notice the numbers.
(c) A NUDGE AT THE WRITE. add_decision and set_decision_status to accepted return a note in the reply when the text carries numbers with units and nothing documents the decision. It lands at the one moment the agent can still act. It never refuses: "asserted by the agent" stays an allowed, visible state, per the accepted requirement. Counter-argument: the same heuristic as (a), and a reply note is easy to scroll past.
(d) FROM THE CALCULATOR'S SIDE. A kept .calc.json already carries supports {design_node}. A reader (reflow2 on a design whose files it can see, or flo2's door when hosted) reports a kept record whose supports node has no DOCUMENTS edge back from it, meaning the math was done and never linked. This leaves flo2-calc unchanged and never resolving anything. Counter-argument: it catches only math that was done, never math that was skipped, which is the failure measured on 2026-10-05.
(e) A CLOSURE LEG. closure_report gains a decisions-rest-on-sourced-numbers leg, so a design that declares a threshold cannot close with unsourced numbers in accepted decisions. It reads whatever (a) or (b) produces, so it adds nothing on its own.

THE AGENT'S READ, A FINDING AND NOT A RANKING ANYONE CHOSE: (b) plus (c) is the strongest pair. (b) makes it structural and reuses accepted intent, and (c) catches the moment it is skipped. (d) is cheap and closes the calculator design's own open point (cap:record-computation is realized, not verified, because no record has been linked to a real decision).

Whether breaking it should stop the build, or stay advice, is the owner's call. The accepted requirement already says "asserted by the agent" is allowed and visible, never refused, which leans toward advice.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-11 — a Decision that rests on numbers names them with their provenance (b), and its write reply flags unsourced ones only when true (a smarter c); (a), (d) and (e) not chosen
properties.rationale: Measured 2026-10-05 (chg:a-decision-resting-on-numbers-keeps-its-math-2026-10-05): three chats with a calculator connected did decision math in their heads, and the one that used it caught a wrong hidden 7.5 mm (really 7.6 mm). The skills now ask for kept math, but asking is judgement, and nothing counts whether it happened.
